pages.title: Connect Xianqiao to Pipes
pages.text: From stage six, place an interface to claim it. Its nine targets are also real local caches. Use an item or container on a slot to select a resource; empty-hand attack first returns the cache, then clears it. Use a configured slot to edit quantity and face masks.

pages.title: Choose a Resource Once
pages.text: Items and fluids can be sampled directly. FE, Botania Mana, Ars Source, Industrial Foregoing Souls and Mekanism chemicals use stable resource keys. Chemicals must be sampled from a real container; the interface never guesses an identity. Missing integrations stay out of the catalogue.

pages.title: Pull and Push
pages.text: Active Pull takes every storable resource from the matching adjacent face, not only configured targets. Active Push sends only real cache contents and obeys the master switch, face mode, and per-slot mask together. Every face starts disabled.

pages.title: Pipes May Still Access It
pages.text: External pipes use the standard capability, independently of the interface scheduler. Disabling an active face does not hide the cache capability. Botania Sparks and directionless Ars interactions have no face concept and therefore follow their official APIs.

pages.title: Safe Retargeting and Pickup
pages.text: Clearing, retargeting, or breaking first returns every cache to Xianqiao atomically. Only a remainder that truly cannot fit is compressed into the dropped block and retried after placement. External resources use independent long-valued ledgers and are no longer fabricated from Immortal Yuan.
